title: Phase 1 workshop paper — first draft
mandate: Theoria.md Phase 4, 阶段交付物: Phase 1 结 = A0-A2 + 电池对既有轨迹的回算, 独立可成 workshop 文

territory.note: PARTNER_SYNC.md appended only. No source report, artefact, contract or other track's file was edited. `git status` in the worktree showed only `?? papers/` before commit.

opening_ritual: Theoria.md (Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 4 deliverables clause, part 3 narrative skeleton)

method.drafting: six sections drafted by parallel subagents against a shared OUTLINE.md carrying the red lines; sections 0, 2 and 7 written in the main context
method.review: one adversarial reviewer subagent (novelty / evidence / reproducibility) -> REVIEW.md; one mechanical citation verifier -> CITECHECK.md; findings applied to the sections, then reassembled
method.figures: data extraction is a script per figure; styling deferred. Byte-determinism verified by running each extractor twice and comparing checksums.

deliverables.sections/: 00 abstract, 01 intro, 02 framework, 03 A0/A0', 04 A1, 05 A2, 06 battery, 07 limitations, 08 related
deliverables.figures/: fig1 concept-birth timeline, fig2 coverage x accuracy, fig3 A2 ledger flow — each a .py extractor, a data/*.json payload and a .txt rendering
deliverables.PROVENANCE.md: every load-bearing number -> its artefact, plus the known source disagreements and which the paper follows
deliverables.OUTLINE.md: the frame the sections were written to
deliverables.CITECHECK.md: the mechanical path / number / quote audit

red_lines.every_number_has_a_path: asserted in OUTLINE.md, indexed in PROVENANCE.md, audited mechanically in CITECHECK.md
red_lines.no_experiment_no_we_show: the paper claims no play result, no baseline comparison and no Phase 3 claim-menu item
red_lines.no_report_was_edited: where a report and a later artefact disagree the paper cites both and says which is later (Fast Downward, §7.3)
red_lines.authorship: placeholder; bibliography unbuilt, every citation marked [bib: TODO]
red_lines.sealed_pile: No sealed-pile game was played or read for any result in this paper, and no API call or network access happened during it. The pile itself is NOT clean, and the paper says so: INC-004 downgrades one game to design_document_disclosed, and INC-BA-001 records nine sealed games whose mechanics leaked to a search subagent. Both predate this run and are disclosed in section 7.1.

findings_recorded_by_this_run: CLAUDE.md's statement that no game has been played and all 25 are `never_audited` is stale: baseline-arms/TOUCHED_GAMES.md records all four development-pile games at `trajectories_reviewed`. Corrected in §7.2 of the paper rather than in CLAUDE.md, which is not this track's file.
cold-start-a0/A0_REPORT.md §5 and §6.5 still read 'Fast Downward is still not connected', which BLOCKER_FAST_DOWNWARD.md and STATUS.md supersede. Both cited; neither edited.

cold-start-a2/artifacts/refutation.json names the exhibit theorem `right_room_locked` where A2_REPORT.md §2/§4 uses `unsolvable`; the paper follows the report's Lean-level name and records the discrepancy in PROVENANCE.md.
engine-rig now ships eight engines, not the six CLAUDE.md lists; `deadlock_carver` and `ic3_pdr` arrived at M9 and are exercised by no result in this paper.

verification.figure_determinism: each extractor run twice before and after the review edits; md5 of all six outputs identical both times
verification.no_network: no API call, no model call outside the drafting subagents, no game spend

not_done: Bibliography. Every reference is a [bib: TODO] marker; none was invented.
Styled figures. The extractors emit data and a plain-text rendering only.
Venue targeting, page limit, and any format conversion.

The length cut. The draft is ~13,700 words against a workshop budget of roughly 4,000; the reviewer's shortening recommendation is accepted but not executed, because cutting is a separate editorial pass and no material should be dropped silently.

The five literatures the reviewer named as uncited (active automata learning, FSM conformance testing, version spaces, optimal experiment design, specification validity) are now acknowledged in prose and carry [bib: TODO] markers, but no bibliography entry exists for any of them.

review.reviewer_verdict: reject as submitted; explicitly a reject of the draft, not of the work
blocking_findings_and_fixes: The headline claim that the two A2 Lean files 'differ in their weight table and in nothing else' is FALSE: diff shows 52 changed lines including `def Goal` (c10 vs c34) and four `step` entries (c31 vs c35, the teleport itself). The claim is in the source report and D-A2-005 too. Fixed by correcting it in the paper, stating what the correction costs the exhibit, and leaving the report unedited.
The abstract's 'no benchmark game was played for any result here' is false -- section 6 reports effect sizes over four played development-pile games. Rewritten to 'no game was played FOR this paper'.
'`locate.py` and `probe.py` import no world module at all' is falsified by one grep (probe.py:59). D-A2-010 says it; the paper no longer repeats it, and states the discipline that actually holds.

'the miss was named, with its three pairs' overstates R-05, which names three DIRECTIONS and one cell; the three-pairs gloss was written at M6 after the score existed. Corrected in the abstract and section 1.1.
Section 3.4 cited `run_b.certify_cheap` for frame and pixel counts; that field is the bare boolean true, and the counts are Run A's. Corrected and the split stated explicitly.
'every discriminative verdict came back underpowered or no-data' is false: discrimination.json has 5 `not-ranked` alongside 11 and 13. Corrected to 24 of 29 ranked metrics, in both places.
